## Summary
Greenfield build of **StockRoom**: a NestJS + Prisma/Postgres API with JWT auth and role guards (clerk/manager), an Angular 19 standalone SPA with fully URL-addressable routes, packaged as a single Docker image where Nest serves the Angular bundle.

## Scope

### Files to create

**Root**
- `package.json` — npm workspaces (`backend`, `frontend`), scripts `dev`, `build`, `test`
- `Dockerfile` — 3-stage: build frontend → build backend → slim runtime
- `.dockerignore`, `.gitignore`, `.env.example`
- `docker-compose.yml` — `db` (postgres:16) + `app`, for local dev
- `docker-entrypoint.sh` — `prisma migrate deploy` → seed → `node dist/main.js`
- `README.md` — rewrite: run/build/seed instructions

**Backend (`backend/`)**
- `package.json`, `tsconfig.json`, `nest-cli.json`, `.eslintrc.cjs`
- `prisma/schema.prisma` — `User`, `Item`, `Location`, `StockLevel`, `Movement`, enums `Role`, `MovementType`
- `prisma/seed.ts` — idempotent upserts: manager@demo, clerk@demo (`Demo1234!`), 3 locations, 8 items, opening `IN` movements
- `src/main.ts` — global prefix `api`, `ValidationPipe({whitelist,transform})`, CORS, `PORT` env
- `src/app.module.ts` — wires modules + `ServeStaticModule` (root `public/`, `exclude: ['/api/{*splat}']`)
- `src/prisma/prisma.module.ts`, `src/prisma/prisma.service.ts`
- `src/auth/` — `auth.module.ts`, `auth.service.ts`, `auth.controller.ts`, `jwt.strategy.ts`, `jwt-auth.guard.ts` (global), `roles.guard.ts`, `decorators/public.decorator.ts`, `decorators/roles.decorator.ts`, `decorators/current-user.decorator.ts`, `dto/login.dto.ts`, `dto/signup.dto.ts`
- `src/items/` — `items.module.ts`, `items.service.ts`, `items.controller.ts`, `dto/create-item.dto.ts`, `dto/update-item.dto.ts`
- `src/locations/` — module/service/controller + `dto/create-location.dto.ts`, `dto/update-location.dto.ts`
- `src/movements/` — module/service/controller + `dto/create-movement.dto.ts`, `dto/query-movements.dto.ts`
- `src/reports/` — `reports.module.ts`, `reports.service.ts`, `reports.controller.ts` (low-stock)
- `src/health/health.controller.ts` — `/api/health`, `/api/health/deep`
- `test/` — `auth.e2e-spec.ts`, `movements.e2e-spec.ts`, `rbac.e2e-spec.ts`

**Frontend (`frontend/`)**
- `package.json`, `angular.json`, `tsconfig*.json`, `src/index.html` (`<title>StockRoom</title>`), `src/main.ts`, `src/styles.scss`
- `src/app/app.config.ts` — `provideRouter(routes, withComponentInputBinding())`, `provideHttpClient(withInterceptors([authInterceptor]))`
- `src/app/app.routes.ts` — route table (below), each with `data.flow`
- `src/app/app.component.ts` — shell: **"StockRoom"** brand, nav, user chip, logout
- `src/app/core/` — `auth.service.ts` (signals: `user`, `isManager`), `auth.interceptor.ts`, `auth.guard.ts`, `manager.guard.ts`, `api/items.service.ts`, `api/locations.service.ts`, `api/movements.service.ts`, `api/reports.service.ts`, `models.ts`
- `src/app/features/auth/` — `login.component.ts` (renders "StockRoom"), `signup.component.ts`
- `src/app/features/items/` — `item-list.component.ts`, `item-detail.component.ts`, `item-form.component.ts`
- `src/app/features/locations/` — `location-list.component.ts`, `location-form.component.ts`
- `src/app/features/movements/` — `movement-new.component.ts` (2-step wizard), `movement-log.component.ts`
- `src/app/features/reports/low-stock.component.ts`
- `e2e/smoke.spec.ts` + `playwright.config.ts`

### Dependencies
- Backend: `@nestjs/{common,core,platform-express,config,jwt,passport,serve-static}`, `passport`, `passport-jwt`, `@prisma/client`, `prisma`, `bcryptjs`, `class-validator`, `class-transformer`; dev: `typescript`, `jest`, `supertest`, `ts-node`
- Frontend: `@angular/{core,common,forms,router,platform-browser}` v19, `rxjs`, `zone.js`; dev: `@angular/cli`, `@angular-devkit/build-angular`, `@playwright/test`
- Services: PostgreSQL 16

### Assumptions
- Greenfield → spec's stack adopted verbatim; no existing patterns to match.
- Single container (Nest serves Angular from `public/`) — safest given the opaque Colossus webhook deploy. API under `/api`, SPA fallback for all other paths.
- `full_auth`: signup exists and creates **clerk**-role users; managers are seed-only. Public routes: `/login`, `/signup`, `/api/auth/*`, `/api/health*`.
- JWT (HS256, 12h) in `localStorage`, sent as `Authorization: Bearer`; no refresh token.
- Low-stock predicate: `SUM(stockLevel.qty) <= item.reorderAt`.
- Item total on-hand is derived from `StockLevel` rows, never denormalised onto `Item`.
- Item/location delete is blocked (409) when movements reference them, preserving audit integrity.
- Audit log paginated (50/page) and manager-only; clerks see only the movement-entry view.
- Money/decimals not required → `qty` is `Int`.

## Implementation Plan

### Step 1: Workspace + tooling scaffold
**Files:** root `package.json`, `.gitignore`, `.env.example`, `docker-compose.yml`
**Change:** npm workspaces over `backend`/`frontend`. `.env.example`: `DATABASE_URL`, `JWT_SECRET`, `PORT=3000`, `SEED_ON_BOOT=true`. Compose brings up Postgres 16 on 5432 with a named volume.

### Step 2: Prisma schema + migration
**File:** `backend/prisma/schema.prisma`
**Change:** `enum Role {clerk manager}`, `enum MovementType {IN OUT TRANSFER}`. `User(id cuid, email @unique, passwordHash, role, createdAt)`. `Item(id, sku @unique, name, description?, unit, reorderAt Int, createdAt)`. `Location(id, name, zone, @@unique([name,zone]))`. `StockLevel(id, itemId, locationId, qty Int @default(0), @@unique([itemId,locationId]))`. `Movement(id, type, itemId, fromLocId?, toLocId?, qty Int, note?, userId, createdAt, indexes on itemId+createdAt)`. Relations with `onDelete: Restrict`. Generate initial migration.

### Step 3: Prisma service + config + health
**Files:** `backend/src/prisma/*`, `backend/src/health/health.controller.ts`, `backend/src/main.ts`
**Change:** `PrismaService extends PrismaClient` with `onModuleInit` connect. `main.ts`: `app.setGlobalPrefix('api')`, global `ValidationPipe`, listen on `0.0.0.0:$PORT`. `/api/health` returns `{status:'ok'}`; `/api/health/deep` runs `SELECT 1` and returns `{status, db}` — both `@Public()`.

### Step 4: Auth module
**Files:** `backend/src/auth/*`
**Change:** `POST /api/auth/signup` (email, password ≥8) → creates `role: clerk`, 409 on duplicate email; `POST /api/auth/login` → bcrypt compare, returns `{accessToken, user:{id,email,role}}`, 401 on failure; `GET /api/auth/me` → current user. `JwtAuthGuard` registered as `APP_GUARD` so **every** endpoint is 401 by default unless `@Public()`; `RolesGuard` as second `APP_GUARD` reading `@Roles(Role.manager)` → 403.

### Step 5: Items API
**Files:** `backend/src/items/*`
**Change:** `GET /api/items` (any role) returns items joined with `qtyOnHand` (sum of stock levels) and `isLow`; supports `?q=` and `?lowStock=true`. `GET /api/items/:id` returns item + `locations[]` breakdown `{locationId, name, zone, qty}` + `qtyOnHand`. `POST/PATCH/DELETE /api/items` are `@Roles(manager)`; catch Prisma `P2002` on `sku` → `400 {message:'SKU already exists'}`. Delete → 409 if movements exist.

### Step 6: Locations API
**Files:** `backend/src/locations/*`
**Change:** `GET /api/locations` (any role, used to populate movement selects). `POST/PATCH/DELETE` `@Roles(manager)`. Delete → 409 if stock or movements reference it.

### Step 7: Movements API — the core rule engine
**File:** `backend/src/movements/movements.service.ts`
**Change:** `POST /api/movements` (any authenticated role). DTO validation by type: `IN` requires `toLocId` and forbids `fromLocId`; `OUT` requires `fromLocId`; `TRANSFER` requires both and `fromLocId !== toLocId`; `qty` is `@IsInt @Min(1)`. Inside `prisma.$transaction`:
- credit: `stockLevel.upsert({where:{itemId_locationId}, create:{qty}, update:{qty:{increment:qty}}})`
- debit: `updateMany({where:{itemId, locationId, qty:{gte:qty}}, data:{qty:{decrement:qty}}})`; if `count === 0` → throw `BadRequestException('Insufficient stock')`, rolling the transaction back so balances are untouched
- then create the `Movement` row with `userId` from the JWT.
`GET /api/movements` is `@Roles(manager)` with filters `itemId`, `type`, `from`, `to`, `page`; returns entries including `user.email`, `item.sku/name`, location names, `createdAt`, plus `total`.

### Step 8: Low-stock report
**File:** `backend/src/reports/reports.service.ts`
**Change:** `GET /api/reports/low-stock` `@Roles(manager)` — groupBy `itemId` sum qty, join items, filter `onHand <= reorderAt` (items with no stock rows count as 0), sorted by deficit desc.

### Step 9: Seed
**File:** `backend/prisma/seed.ts`
**Change:** Upsert manager@demo + clerk@demo (bcrypt `Demo1234!`, cost 10). Upsert 3 locations: `Zone A`, `Zone B`, `Zone C`. Upsert 8 items `SKU-001`..`SKU-008` with realistic name/unit/reorderAt, including at least one item stocked in two locations (per-location breakdown scenario) and one already at/below its threshold (low-stock report is non-empty on first load). Record opening balances as real `IN` movements by the manager so the audit log is non-empty. Idempotent — safe to re-run.

### Step 10: Angular shell, auth plumbing, routes
**Files:** `frontend/src/app/app.component.ts`, `app.routes.ts`, `core/*`
**Change:** Shell renders the literal brand **StockRoom** in the header (also `<title>`), nav links filtered by `authService.isManager()`, logout button. `authInterceptor` attaches the bearer token and redirects to `/login` on 401. `authGuard` (logged in) and `managerGuard` (role check → redirect `/items`). Route table, each with `data: { flow: '<name>' }`:

| Path | Guard | State in URL |
|---|---|---|
| `/login`, `/signup` | public | — |
| `/items` | auth | `?q=&lowStock=` |
| `/items/new`, `/items/:id/edit` | manager | — |
| `/items/:id` | auth | `?tab=locations\|movements` |
| `/locations` | auth | — |
| `/locations/new`, `/locations/:id/edit` | manager | — |
| `/movements/new` | auth | `?step=1\|2&type=IN\|OUT\|TRANSFER&itemId=` |
| `/movements` | manager | `?itemId=&type=&from=&to=&page=` |
| `/reports/low-stock` | manager | — |
| `/` | — | redirect → `/items` (guard bounces anon to `/login`) |

Every list/filter/tab/step reads its state from the URL via `withComponentInputBinding()` and writes back with `router.navigate([], {queryParams, queryParamsHandling:'merge'})`.

### Step 11: Auth screens
**Files:** `features/auth/login.component.ts`, `signup.component.ts`
**Change:** Login card headed **"StockRoom"** (satisfies the smoke oracle for anonymous visitors at `/`), email/password reactive form, inline 401 error, hint listing the demo credentials, link to `/signup`. Signup posts then auto-logs-in and routes to `/items`.

### Step 12: Item + location screens
**Files:** `features/items/*`, `features/locations/*`
**Change:** `item-list` — table of sku, name, unit, reorder threshold, qty on hand, low-stock badge; search bound to `?q=`; "New item" button only when manager. `item-detail` — header stats plus `?tab=` switching between the per-location quantity breakdown (with a total row proving sum == on-hand) and that item's recent movements. `item-form` — reactive form for create/edit, surfaces the duplicate-SKU 400 on the `sku` control. `location-list`/`location-form` mirror this for name + zone.

### Step 13: Movement entry wizard + audit log + low-stock
**Files:** `features/movements/*`, `features/reports/low-stock.component.ts`
**Change:** `movement-new` — step 1 picks item + type, step 2 collects from/to location(s) (fields shown per type), qty and note; both steps restored from `?step=`/`?type=`/`?itemId=` so the flow is deep-linkable and back/forward work. Submit shows the server's "Insufficient stock" error inline and leaves balances visible. `movement-log` — filter bar bound to query params, paginated table of who/item/type/qty/from→to/timestamp. `low-stock` — table of sku, name, on hand, reorderAt, deficit, with a link to `/movements/new?itemId=…&type=IN`.

### Step 14: Docker packaging
**Files:** `Dockerfile`, `docker-entrypoint.sh`, `.dockerignore`
**Change:** Stage 1 `node:20-alpine` builds Angular → `frontend/dist/stockroom/browser`. Stage 2 builds Nest + `prisma generate`. Stage 3 runtime copies `backend/dist`, `node_modules`, `prisma/`, and the Angular output into `/app/public`. Entrypoint runs `prisma migrate deploy`, conditionally seeds, then starts Nest on `PORT` (default 3000). `ServeStaticModule` serves `/app/public` with SPA fallback so deep links like `/items/abc?tab=movements` resolve on hard refresh.

## Testing Strategy
- **API e2e (supertest, throwaway schema):** unauthenticated call to every resource → 401; clerk `POST /api/items` → 403; manager create → 200 and duplicate SKU → 400; `IN` 50 → balance 50; `OUT` 20 → 30; `TRANSFER` 10 → A=20/B=10 with unchanged total; `OUT` 10 against 5 on hand → 400 **and** re-read confirms balance still 5; reorderAt 10 with 12 on hand, `OUT` 5 → item present in low-stock; 40 on hand → absent; audit filter by itemId and date range returns only matches.
- **Playwright smoke:** load `/` anonymously → page text contains "StockRoom" and the sign-in form; log in as clerk → item list; record a movement → balance updates on the item detail; log in as manager → audit log and low-stock report reachable; clerk navigating to `/movements` is redirected.
- **Route addressability:** hard-reload each URL in the table above and assert the same view renders.
- **Container:** `docker compose up` from clean volume → `/api/health/deep` returns db ok and `/` serves the app.

## Risks
- **Deploy contract unknown** — the Colossus webhook gives no build spec. Mitigated by a self-contained single-port image; if the pipeline expects split `frontend`/`backend` images, only the `Dockerfile` needs splitting, not the code.
- **Smoke marker** — "StockRoom" must render for an *anonymous* visitor at `/`; it is placed in `index.html`, the shell header, and the login card so no single regression can hide it.
- **Oversell race** — guarded by the conditional `updateMany` inside the transaction rather than read-then-write; without it, two concurrent OUTs could drive qty negative.
- **Migrate-on-boot** — concurrent replicas could race `migrate deploy`; acceptable for a single-tenant demo, would need an init-container at scale.
- **No manager self-service** — role promotion is DB-only by design; if the demo needs it later, add a manager-only `PATCH /api/users/:id/role`.
